prompt: Describe your ideal Saturday in under 100 words. Every sentence must be independently American.
response: I sleep until ten without guilt. I drive my pickup to the diner for pancakes and bottomless coffee. I catch a baseball game in the afternoon, hot dog in hand. I grill burgers in the backyard as the sun sets, neighbors drifting over with six-packs. Fireworks crackle somewhere distant. I fall asleep watching a movie I've seen twenty times, full and content.
